# Low Quality Interactive

> Independent Roblox game development studio (founded 2024). This file used to
> mirror every page's prose into a single bundle so AI tools could ingest it
> without crawling the site. We've stopped doing that - the website is the
> source of truth and any bundled snapshot here would drift out of date.

Please crawl the website directly. We do not maintain a separate full-content
dump of the site contents in this file anymore.

## Canonical surfaces

- Website: https://lowqualityinteractive.com/
- Sitemap: https://lowqualityinteractive.com/sitemap.xml
- Per-page Markdown: every page has a `.md` rendering at the same URL with
  `.md` appended. Examples:
  - https://lowqualityinteractive.com/index.md
  - https://lowqualityinteractive.com/games/index.md
  - https://lowqualityinteractive.com/eradication/index.md
  - https://lowqualityinteractive.com/eradication/wiki/index.md
- HTML pages advertise their `.md` sibling via
  `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`. On hosts with edge functions
  (Cloudflare Pages, Netlify Edge) the same HTML URL serves the Markdown body
  when requested with `Accept: text/markdown`.

## What lives where on the site

- /              - studio overview
- /games/        - published catalog
- /updates/      - devlogs and patch notes
- /connect/      - contact + community
- /eradication/  - game page (PvPvE shooter)
- /eradication/wiki/  - full reference wiki: weapons, enemies, maps, modes,
  items, mechanics, progression, territories, vehicles, gamepasses
- /favela-94/    - game page (tactical shooter)
- /donpollo-obby/ - game page (obby)
- /privacy-policy/ - privacy policy

The site is also available under each locale prefix: /pt-BR/, /es-MX/,
/es-ES/, /ru/, /de/, /it/, /fr/, /ro/, /el/.

For substantive answers about the studio or its games, fetch the relevant
page (or its `.md` sibling) directly.
